name: Perdana Petroleum Berhad
overview: 2026年，Perdana Petroleum Berhad 的公告主要涉及公司治理、股本重组（拟削减及注销6亿令吉已发行股本）、股东授权更新及股份分拆上市，未见涉及新业务、新合约或业务退出的公告。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比下滑35.8%，净利润同比下滑89.1%。
overview_en: In 2026, Perdana Petroleum Berhad's announcements mainly concerned corporate governance, a proposed capital reduction and cancellation of RM600 million of issued share capital, renewal of shareholders' mandate, and additional listings following share subdivision; no announcements related to new businesses, new contracts, or business exits were observed. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue declined 35.8% year-on-year and net profit declined 89.1% year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 今年公告主要涉及股本重组、股东授权更新及股份分拆上市等公司层面事项，未披露各业务板块的具体运营变化。
segments.note_en: This year's announcements mainly cover company-level matters such as capital restructuring, renewal of shareholders' mandate, and additional listings following share subdivision;

actions.text: 以进行经常性关联交易。
